d: I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class (Class no 2-banme ni Kawaii Onna no Ko to Tomodachi ni Natta) is a 2026 romantic comedy anime following Maki Maehara, an isolated loner who unexpectedly befriends Umi Asanagi, a popular and stunning girl often overshadowed by the "prettiest" girl, leading to a secret relationship.
